description: This PHP source file defines an API class `OptionalFieldAPI` for managing optional fields configuration in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for retrieving and updating optional field settings such as SSN, SIN, tax exemptions, and deprecated fields status, utilizing annotations for OpenAPI documentation and implementing validation rules.

classes.name: OptionalFieldAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints to retrieve and modify optional fields configuration for HR systems, with methods for GET and PUT requests, validation, and configuration handling.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves current optional field configuration settings, returning them as an array model within an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the optional field configuration based on request parameters and returns the updated config.

methods.name: saveOptionalFields
methods.description: Saves the incoming configuration parameters (SSN, SIN, tax exemptions, deprecated fields) via configuration service and returns the current parameter array.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET endpoint, requiring a specific parameter ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the UPDATE endpoint, ensuring boolean values for all configurable parameters.
